thread:
ella_marketing: Need a compact benchmark sweep for the webinar + launch blog. Ask: latency p50/p95 across two models and quant modes, payloads 16/128/512, concurrencies 1/6. 2 trials each, warmup 15. Can runtime run today and deliver CSV + 1 sample JSON?

max_runtime: Can do. Please confirm models and whether to include cold-starts. Also runtime window?

ella_marketing: Models: rwd-mini, rwd-medium. Quant: fp16, int8. Include cold and warmed after 15 warmups. Keep run under 2.5h.

oren_analytics: Add estimated $/k tokens per row and a quick note about variance thresholds (flag if p95 CV > 0.25). I'll make the plots.

max_runtime: Running: runbench --models rwd-mini,rwd-medium --quant fp16,int8 --payloads 16,128,512 --conc 1,6 --warmup 15 --trials 2 --capture csv,json --note "marketing-219877". Using bench-nodes-gpuA; cold runs will flush cache.

ci-bot: Job queued: job_id=bench-219877-01; est duration ~1h50m

max_runtime: Uploaded partial: s3://redwood-marketing/bench/219877/partial-cold-int8.csv. Full artifacts on completion. Will include stderr logs for any kernel fallbacks and a small summary JSON (stats + flags).

ella_marketing: Great. If int8 shows unexpected regression at 512 tokens, flag immediately. We'll decide whether to show or call out caveats.

max_runtime: Noted. Will post final CSV + one sample generation JSON and a short README about infra and warmup semantics when done.

oren_analytics: Perfect. I'll watch for the CSV and prep a heatmap and a short caption that emphasizes int8 win at 128 tokens if it holds.

ci-bot: Job started: bench-219877-01 at 2198771188

max_runtime: Quick note: slight p95 jitter at conc=6 for int8 in early trials; capturing extra trace.

ella_marketing: Thanks, team. Ping here when artifacts are uploaded.
